Specification: This specification models a trivial one-variable system intended as a test of TLC's runtime checking behavior rather than a real distributed algorithm. The variable x is initialized to the string value "a", and the Init predicate invokes Print on both a diagnostic message and the expression x \in Nat, specifically to test that TLC rejects membership in Nat when x is not numeric. The next-state action stutters by assigning x' = x and prints a failure message, so the notable design decision is that the spec is constructed to trigger an error during initialization instead of to verify a substantive temporal correctness property.
